structure: One fixed primary stochastic law generates both measurements on each independent person. CHNS evidence-community aggregates determine mixture probabilities and marginal parameters. Population-level matching is analytical, not finite-sample enforcement. Rejection sampling implements the joint density without seed selection or sample-moment adjustment.

parameter_provenance.source: Supplied CHNS A-only supplement, population description and Tables 1–2
parameter_provenance.population: Linked complete-case women aged 18–49 in evidence communities, regardless of pregnancy or inflammation; distinct from Zhu et al.
parameter_provenance.measurement: Central whole-blood Hb in g/dL and uncorrected serum ferritin in micrograms/L; unweighted and unadjusted.
parameter_provenance.reported_values_used: Band counts 206, 619, 298; depleted counts 123, 148, 59; all six Hb means/SDs and all six ferritin GMs/GSDs in Table 2.
parameter_provenance.use: Counts determine band and depletion probabilities. Beta parameters match bounded-band Hb means and variances; shifted-gamma parameters match the upper-band mean and variance. Two positive log-ferritin scales match each band's log mean, log variance and depletion probability.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Reported sample SDs are treated as population plug-in SDs. Aggregate parameter uncertainty is not propagated; the supplement supplies no uncertainty for the joint distribution.

parameter_provenance.source: Zhu et al., 2010, DOI 10.1024/0300-9831/a000014, Methods pp. 145–146 and Table III p. 150
parameter_provenance.population: Separate June 2004 rural Hebei sample: 1,671 selected nonpregnant, nonlactating mothers, predominantly aged 25–35, using IUD contraception and subject to health and supplement exclusions.
parameter_provenance.measurement: Hemocue Hb and plasma ferritin; Hb bands below 100, 100–119 and at least 120 g/L.
parameter_provenance.reported_values_used: Ferritin GMs 1.3, 5.9 and 22.3 micrograms/L across increasing Hb bands.
parameter_provenance.use: Qualitative support for positive Hb–ferritin dependence, especially among women with low Hb. No pooling with CHNS and no numerical transport of the adjusted anemia OR.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Population selection and assays differ. Reported intervals are not used as individual-level SDs or calibration weights.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Within-band dependence coefficients 0.9, 0.6, 0.2; bounded beta-score powers 8 and 1; upper-band centered exponential Hb score; tanh normal-latent score.
parameter_provenance.use: Adds positive residual association that weakens at higher Hb while preserving every fitted marginal. These coefficients are density-kernel parameters, not correlations or odds ratios.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Not identified by the supplied aggregates. They represent one nominated law, not evidence-estimated precision.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Scaled-beta Hb below 14, shifted-gamma Hb above 14, and threshold-anchored two-piece-normal log ferritin.
parameter_provenance.use: Positive continuous measurements with evidence-based band moments and ferritin threshold probabilities; evidence-community parameters are transported unchanged to other communities under the same CHNS design.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Distribution tails, within-band shapes and transportability are unverified.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted crude odds ratio
requested_estimands.definition: Odds of hb_g_dl <12 among ferritin_ug_l <15 divided by the corresponding odds among ferritin_ug_l >=15.
requested_estimands.support: The primary law's population OR is the Table 1 plug-in value 123*710/(83*207), approximately 5.083. Realized finite-sample ORs vary and can be undefined in small cohorts.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted Spearman rank correlation
requested_estimands.definition: Correlation of ranks of continuous, uncorrected hb_g_dl and ferritin_ug_l on the same generated people.
requested_estimands.support: Partly informed by CHNS between-band differences; within-band ranks depend on the nominated association kernel. No Spearman estimate is reported in the supplied evidence or claimed as validated.

limitations: The most consequential remaining assumption is within-band dependence: many joint laws share all supplied aggregates yet yield different Spearman correlations. The chosen positive, weakening association is scientifically motivated but not identified.
Transport from evidence communities to other CHNS communities is assumed; community heterogeneity and clustering are not modeled.
Pregnancy, inflammation, age, geography and other causes of anemia are not explicitly generated. Their aggregate effects are absorbed into the fitted two-variable law.
Band boundaries create artificial changes in density, and extrapolated tails are unverified. No inflammation or altitude correction is applied.
Repeated simulated cohorts quantify sampling variation under this fixed law, not uncertainty about transport or model structure; neither estimand is causal.
checks_actually_performed: Manual count reconciliation: 206+619+298=1123; 123+148+59=330; nonanemic depleted count 148+59=207 and nonanemic nondepleted count 710 agree with Table 1.
Manual arithmetic: the Table 1 crude OR is approximately 5.083.

Analytical construction check: centered bounded Hb scores and the odd tanh normal score preserve both marginal distributions under the stated rejection density; coefficients have absolute value below one.
Static interface review: generate reads spec['model'] and spec['task']['n_rows'], ignores observed for whole-cohort synthesis, uses only allowed dependencies, and returns the three requested columns.
No execution, generated-only validation, source-check adapter or network retrieval was available or performed.
